  "title": "Full Stack Engineer",
  "description": "Tongston is a multi-award-winning brand providing entrepreneurial education, media, enterprise &amp; finance services for sustainable socio-economic development. T-World is Tongston&#39;s AI powered digital entrepreneurial thinking ecosystem providing integrated media, enterprise, finance and entrepreneurial education services to K-12 Students, HE Students, Entrepreneurs, Intrapreneurs and their institutions globally to become Valuable, Influential &amp; Profitable. For more information, visit tongston.com

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Full Stack Engineer (Back-End Focus &mdash; Node.js, MongoDB, AI Enablement, Web3 Exposure + Front-End Supportive - React (Web)

Job Location: Remote
Employment Type: Contract

Overview


	Tongston is seeking a Full Stack Engineer (Back-End Focus) to help build and scale T-World, an AI-powered platform spanning education, enterprise, media, and finance.
	This role is ideal for a backend-leaning engineer who can own APIs, data models, integrations, reliability, and AI workflows&mdash;while remaining comfortable delivering lightweight React web UI when needed to support product flows and internal tools. You will Participate in Agile ceremonies: planning, execution, review, and iteration.


Core Stack
Back-End (Primary Focus):


	Node.js with Express (API services / serverless routes where applicable)
	MongoDB (Atlas &amp; Compass)


Front-End (Supportive):


	React (Web)
	Vite
	Tailwind CSS
	State &amp; data: TanStack Query, Zustand


Platform &amp; Infrastructure:


	Authentication: Firebase (synced with MongoDB)
	Storage:
	
		Cloudinary (short-term media handling)
		AWS S3 (long-term storage with immediate migration )
	
	
	CI/CD: GitHub Actions
	Security: CodeQL, Dependabot, basic OWASP-aligned practices


AI Tooling:


	LangChain (or similar orchestration frameworks)
	API-based LLM workflows


Web3 (Exposure-Level):


	Wallets, signing flows, token interactions-conversion
	On-chain vs off-chain boundaries
	(Deep smart contract development is not required)


Roles and Responsibilities
Back-End &amp; Architecture (Primary):


	Build and maintain server-side services and APIs using Node.js and Express
	Design, implement, and optimize MongoDB schemas, indexes, and query patterns
	Own backend integrations including:
	
		Authentication (Firebase)
		Media storage (Cloudinary, AWS S3)
		Environment configuration and secrets management
		Logging and monitoring
	
	
	Define modular service boundaries aligned with T-World&rsquo;s product structure (widgets, modules, sub-features)
	Ensure backend reliability, performance, and scalability


Front-End Support (Secondary):


	Ship or support React components required to validate backend APIs, AI flows, or admin/internal tooling
	Collaborate with frontend engineers to ensure clean API contracts and smooth UI &harr; backend interactions
	Maintain code quality via pull requests, documentation, and shared standards


AI Enablement:


	Integrate AI workflows across modules (UI &rarr; API &rarr; AI &rarr; DB)
	Support AI-powered experiences such as:
	
		Assistants
		Search
		Content generation
	
	
	Ensure safe and reliable AI integrations, including:
	
		Error handling and fallbacks
		Latency and timeout management
		Rate limiting and caching
		Prompt and version management
		Traceable outputs for debugging and evaluation
	
	


Delivery, Security &amp; Operations:


	Support CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions
	Follow secure practices for:
	
		Secrets and key management
		Access control and offboarding hygiene
	
	
	Contribute to deployment, monitoring, and operational stability


Knowledge, Skills &amp; Attitude Requirements
Technical Knowledge &amp; Skills:


	Strong experience with Node.js and backend design patterns
	Strong experience with MongoDB (schema design, indexing, aggregation, performance tuning)
	Solid working knowledge of Express.js
	Comfort working with React for integration-level UI tasks
	Familiarity with REST APIs, server-side architecture, and environment configuration


Soft Skills &amp; Attitude:


	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
	Clear communication and collaboration across teams
	Ability to prioritize, execute, and deliver with attention to detail
	Ownership mindset and comfort working in a fast-paced environment
	Strong alignment with Tongston&rsquo;s mission, values, and culture. Learn more about Tongston&rsquo;s culture


Nice-to-Have Knowledge &amp; Skills:


	Exposure to AI integrations (LangChain or similar)
	Familiarity with Web3 integration workflows (wallets, signing, token flows)
	Experience with background jobs, queues, or serverless patterns
	Exposure to cloud infrastructure (AWS)


Benefits


	Monthly professional fee of NGN200,000.
	A monthly Remote Productivity Support Package.
	A company-provided laptop and access to Tongston-funded platforms, software, licensed tools and other approved resources required to perform your role effectively.
	Pathway to full-time employment opportunity to secure additional benefits, including pension, HMO, statutory employee leave categories, promotion-based entitlements, and staff welfare benefits.&nbsp;
	Exposure to user research, product strategy, user journeys, wireframing, prototyping, usability testing, analytics-informed design improvement, and cross-functional product delivery across web, mobile and other digital platforms.
	Team-based execution and support, including an overall project management structure, reporting to a line manager, and collaboration within a sprint-based team workflow with defined weekly deliverables.
	A structured learning and growth pathway supported through twice-yearly performance review, development and growth conversations (January &amp; July). If you join after a review cycle, your first review will take place in the next review window. The review helps you document and communicate how you&rsquo;ve grown, developed and demonstrated being Valuable, Influential &amp; Profitable.
	Learning &amp; Development budget: NGN350,000 to support continuous upskilling, role-specific learning and broader professional development.
	Up to 10 working days of approved paid time away from active delivery annually.
	Eligible for the Tongston Annual Personnel High Performance Award which comes with cash prizes and certificates you can include in your profile for future jobs.
	Professional Visibility: listed on Tongston&rsquo;s website.
	Complimentary premium access to T-World, Tongston&rsquo;s integrated digital platform.&nbsp;
	Eligibility for discretionary performance-based bonus/allocation
	Participation in Tongston Academy sessions (scheduled periodically):
	
		Personal branding (includes CV/LinkedIn review)
		Personal finance &amp; investing
		Sales, communication &amp; networking
		Business development &amp; strategy
		Project management, Cybersecurity awareness &amp; Digital automation tools.
	
	


Note


	Fill the form where you can provide information about yourself.
	Upload your CV &amp; portfolio where applicable, and answer some basic pre-screening questions that demonstrate how you meet the knowledge, skills and attitude requirements for the role, in line with the JD
	Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, so we strongly encourage early submission.
	If you have any questions or clarifications, please write to us at info@tongston.com with pifhr@tongston.com in copy. Please use the subject &ldquo;IC Application for - [name of the role]&rdquo; in directing any correspondences to us.
	If shortlisted, you will progress through the rest of the recruitment process - technical assessment, personality &amp; multiple intelligence check, conversation with the line manager and one or more team members, reference checks, and, if successful, an offer &amp; if accepted, onboarding.
	Although this is a remote opportunity, candidates based in Gombe, Bauchi, Ilorin, Lagos or Abuja will be viewed favourably.
	For candidates who have not yet completed their NYSC, we may also be able to consider an NYSC engagement, particularly for those based in Gombe, Lagos or Abuja.

  "description": "Bluetti is a global leader in portable power solutions, dedicated to providing innovative, high-performance energy products to customers worldwide. We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Sales Manager

Job Location: Lagos
Job type: Full time

Job Summary


	Bluetti Energy Nigeria Limited is currently recruiting qualified candidates for Sales Manager position based in Lagos and Ekiti branch
	The ideal candidate will be responsible for leading Bluetti&rsquo;s sales team to drive sales growth, manage sales operations, build strong client relationships, and achieve business targets.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and implement sales strategies to grow Bluetti&rsquo;s presence in assigned regions.
	Monitor sales performance and report insights to senior management.
	Lead, manage, mentor, and motivate a team.
	Provide ongoing training and guidance to ensure high performance.
	Set sales targets and track team achievements.
	Build and maintain relationships with key clients, distributors, and partners.
	Analyze market trends, track competitor activities, and recommend sales strategies.
	Oversee promotional campaigns, trade shows, and marketing initiatives.
	Lead negotiations with potential clients and secure large-scale sales deals.
	Ensure the team follows up on all sales leads and closes deals efficiently.
	Identify new business opportunities and markets for expansion.


Requirements &amp; Qualifications


	Minimum of HND or BSc in Business Administration, Marketing, or related field.
	Minimum of 8 years of experience in sales
	Must have worked as a manager for at least 5 years within the renewable solar energy sector (Please note: This is a mandatory requirement, please do not apply if you don&rsquo;t have this experience).
	Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
	Strong leadership, communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
	Familiarity with CRM software and sales analytics tools.
	Ability to work independently, travel extensively, and manage a multi-state sales team.


Key Competencies &amp; Attributes:

The Pistis Firm, a Consulting Recruitment, and HR Services company, is recruiting suitable candidates to fill the following positions below:

1.) Inventory Supervisor

Job Location: Lagos Island, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description


	The Pistis Firm is recruiting an experienced Inventory Supervisor to oversee warehouse inventory operations.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining accurate stock records, supervising inventory activities, conducting stock counts, resolving discrepancies, and ensuring efficient warehouse operations.


Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Supervise daily inventory and warehouse operations.
	Maintain accurate inventory records and stock levels.
	Conduct routine stock counts and reconcile inventory discrepancies.
	Ensure proper storage, labelling, and organisation of warehouse goods.
	Prepare inventory reports and support stock replenishment.
	Lead the inventory team and ensure compliance with warehouse procedures.


Requirements


	HND / BSc in a relevant discipline.
	Minimum of 3 years of experience in inventory or warehouse operations.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and inventory management software.
	Strong leadership, organisational, and problem-solving skills.
	Excellent attention to detail and communication skills.

N250,000 - N350,000 per month.

	For more information contact recruiter on 08160326808 (WhatsApp)
